newestRows.title: Add Predge to ecosystem (Services/Endpoints)
newestRows.author: predge-ai
newestRows.summary: Predge — signed, offline-verifiable settled outcomes plus prediction-market whale intelligence over x402. Wallets are ranked by outcome-verified win rate on resolved markets (edge over the market's own price × capital, not activity heuristics). The differentiator is four flagship ed25519 attestations — settled Polymarket outcomes, sports results, Kalshi market resolutions, and wallet track records — each cryptographically signed and verifiable **offline** against a published key, so an agent can prove an outcome rather than just assert it. Pay-per-call in USDC on **Base or Solana**, no keys, no accounts.

newestRows.title: docs: add a Cloudflare Worker bazaar seller example
newestRows.author: brentdubose17-ops
newestRows.summary: Adds a Cloudflare Worker example that returns `extensions.bazaar` (input schema and output example) in the 402 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header. Buyers are expected to copy `extensions` onto `PaymentPayload`; `x402Client.createPaymentPayload` does this, while `validateExtensions` currently still accepts a missing `bazaar` key. When the client omits it, the worker attaches the seller’s own block before verify and settle, which is safe because the exact-scheme signature does not cover `PaymentPayload.extensions`. The directory is not a workspace package, so the examples lockfile is unchanged.

rows.title: docs: add a Cloudflare Worker bazaar seller example
rows.author: brentdubose17-ops
rows.summary: Adds a Cloudflare Worker example that returns `extensions.bazaar` (input schema and output example) in the 402 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header. Buyers are expected to copy `extensions` onto `PaymentPayload`; `x402Client.createPaymentPayload` does this, while `validateExtensions` currently still accepts a missing `bazaar` key. When the client omits it, the worker attaches the seller’s own block before verify and settle, which is safe because the exact-scheme signature does not cover `PaymentPayload.extensions`. The directory is not a workspace package, so the examples lockfile is unchanged.
